purpose: Admission and incremental-release contract. The first local release has six selected facts; this contract imposes no permanent six-, 23- or 1000-record limit.
authority: Existing human fact and source acceptance controls admission. The user's prototype request authorizes implementing this first subset, not accepting pending records.
allowed_ingestion_entrypoint: One explicitly selected data/release/manifest.json and only the payloads and fact IDs listed in it.
extension_steps: Register a candidate source and its exact URL/revision, retrieval date, provenance lineage and permitted use scope. Save source bytes and hashes when normally obtainable; state gaps honestly.
Keep unreviewed material in staging. A source being official, publicly viewable or available on Hugging Face does not itself establish reuse rights or field accuracy.
Extract atomic claims with explicit reference version, walking endpoints, direction, unit and measurement definition. Preserve source-stated estimates as estimates.
Normalize Unicode and spacing, typed units and identifiers. Do not silently correct numbers, merge aliases, join track gaps or infer missing measurements.
Compare matching quantities and boundaries. Keep distinct route versions and independent source lineages separate. Register conflicts instead of averaging or selecting by page count.
Review source rights and each factual payload. Bind explicit human acceptance to the exact content checksum and source-record revision/hash. Changes to factual content reset affected review.
Create a new release ID and explicit fact/source allowlist. Preserve prior releases. Recheck the implementation scope and evaluation evidence when a new topic or reference is added.

Validate IDs, checksums, current-use restrictions, dependency closure and attribution. Construct a new index fingerprint from release checksum plus embedding model/revision/dimension/chunking configuration; never mix incompatible vectors.
Run relevant development checks, inspect failure cases and return the iteration for human review before freezing the next version. Roll back by selecting a prior verified release/index pair.
current_use_priority: An excluded or suspended current-use decision overrides an older ACCEPT. Neither a valid schema nor an accepted licence admits a pending factual claim.
example_exclusion: K09 is excluded and K01–K06 distances are suspended. W05–W06/P01–P02 and all other pending records remain outside the first prototype release.

text_construction.first_chunking_rule: One atomic fact per chunk. Preserve the complete ordered K08 endpoint sequence and each fact's qualification and reference metadata. Do not split a short record merely to create more chunks.
text_construction.future_document_rule: If later accepted source documents need longer chunks, use semantic sections with explicit route boundaries and source locators; test the change separately. A chunk size setting cannot expand the approved source use scope.

licence_handling: Keep O01 CC BY 4.0 and O03 CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution distinct, including the O03 imported CC BY-SA 3.0-work notice/history link. Do not infer licences for images, other linked sources, project code or model weights.
implementation_note: This file describes the contract. Runtime import, index rebuild and release validation must enforce it; descriptions alone are not proof of enforcement.
